sources.title: CNN: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
sources.snippet: An assistant conducts cancer vaccine research in the lab at the Moderna Inc. headquarters in Cambridge, Massachusetts, US, on Tuesday, March 26, 2024. The forthcoming RSV shot, expected to get US regulatory approval this month, is Moderna's first chance to show the versatility of mRNA technology to more effectively treat and prevent a range of illnesses from the flu to cancer. It will be the first mRNA product for something other than Covid. Photographer: Adam Glanzman/Bloomberg via Getty [...] WASHINGTON, DC - SEPTEMBER 20: The White House is seen from the South Lawn on September 20, 2026 in Washington, DC. The Supreme Court let construction resume on the ballroom on August 31 in a 5-4 ruling. The Trump administration has also built a new heli-pad on White House grounds and is moving forward with plans for a "triumphal arch". (Photo by Samuel Corum/Getty Images) [...] Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky during a bilateral meeting with US President Donald Trump on the sidelines of the 81st United Nations General Assembly in New York, on September 22, 2026. (Photo by Brendan SMIALOWSKI / AFP via Getty Images)
